judge_inputs: Inspect the actual service,normal canonical reports,command traces and source-bound evidence. No synthetic observation overlay is supplied. This stage verifies the actual instrumented pipeline workspace when preconditions are supplied. Execute the bound scenarios/read-only application checks and produce current verification evidence. If a standalone invocation genuinely lacks its canonical audit/selection,report that exact blocker without fabricating a pass or editing application code. A prerequisite-negative control is not positive runtime proof.

For positive implementation/verification,inspect raw .observe/logging-workflow-proof evidence,actual stdout/stderr and exact received span/log joins from the unchanged host checker. The independent pipeline also reruns that checker;self-reported success alone is insufficient.

Return exactly one check per criterion with IDs rubric-1 through rubric-14. Keep unselected/unsupported and unexecuted cases honest;do not require optional app features solely because a reference mentions them.

Prerequisite-negative applicability: inspect the actual service and canonical files first. Only when this is the untouched uninstrumented standalone fixture and its required audit/selection are genuinely absent, the correct outcome is the exact prerequisite blocker with no application edits, fabricated reports or runtime pass. For that negative control, rubric-3 through rubric-14 have no executable instrumentation claims to assess: mark them satisfied only with explicit Not applicable: prerequisite-negative; no runtime coverage credit notes and verified absence of contrary claims. Do not demand post-gate source analysis or tests that the skill correctly refused to run. This exception is forbidden in the paired workflow when the actual canonical audit/selection and instrumented service exist; all applicable positive obligations and real checker evidence remain required there.

Studio live telemetry is intentionally evicted when the producer exits. The unchanged host checker captures its exact SDK log/span joins and native-count snapshot while the app is alive, then proves bounded owned-process cleanup. Live capture and cleanup do not establish post-exit persistence or final-record SDK drain; those require separate selected receipt evidence. Do not classify expected explorer eviction as missing application wiring.
rubric: Uses the requested loaded skill against the actual service and its current state. Distinguishes source/config/default evidence from executed telemetry;does not use imagined overlay observations or fabricated outcomes. This stage verifies the actual instrumented pipeline workspace when preconditions are supplied. Execute the bound scenarios/read-only application checks and produce current verification evidence. If a standalone invocation genuinely lacks its canonical audit/selection,report that exact blocker without fabricating a pass or editing application code. A prerequisite-negative control is not positive runtime proof. Proof modes are per evidence row: focused SDK/bridge/receiver proof uses a supported focused mode such as unit+otlp; preserve app_test for actual application-test proof, and never upgrade a focused probe to full_runtime because a separate test starts the app. Audit uses proof_level: focused call-site or a justified either for isolated capability fixtures; full runtime requires the normal app/agent startup dependency. Audit keeps all boundaries planned, not executed. A synthetic LoggingEvent/appender probe remains focused SDK/bridge proof even with an attached javaagent; agent startup alone does not make it app_test/full_runtime. Determine scenario AND item proof modes from the actual path, not audit proof_level, package/test filename or suite command: isolated in-memory SDK/bridge proof is unit; decoded loopback SDK export is unit+otlp; an actual application-owned helper/setup test can legitimately be app_test; full_runtime requires the claimed normal application path. Do not map every focused scenario to app_test or every item to full_runtime. Item mode describes its direct assertion scope: actual runtime proof can legitimately coexist with clearly scoped ancillary focused/incomplete scenarios. Do not fail merely because those are attached; fail an unsupported combined claim or mechanical first-scenario mode/visibility that misrepresents the item evidence.

Preserve canonical audit/selection bindings, immutable IDs/source and read-only boundaries. Audit plans; instrumentation implements authorized scope; verification proves current behavior without editing/rebinding the audit. Reconcile every selected promise, field, trigger, named input, operation, event order and negative control to addressable assertions. The required-controls helper inventories telemetry promises, not all applicable source clauses. Grouped/parameterized cases are valid when individually addressable. Derive scenario/item verdicts and visibility from their own evidence; aggregate success, copied acceptance, helper syntax or a related pass cannot close missing controls. Direct item proof may coexist with incomplete ancillary scenarios, but cannot support a broader claim. Keep unmatched required controls Not proven.

Scope configuration coverage to app-owned/new overrides, supplied selected settings, requirements necessary to application/operator invariants, and every actual capability/default claim at its claimed scope. A versioned delegated default is a source fact, not a promise of every input variant or runtime conformance. Include dependent Resource, propagation/sampling, bridge/provider activation, filtering/SDK-disabled, selected limits and lifecycle behavior. Mere transitive SDK consumption does not require enumerating/testing every unused upstream setting. Ordinary delegated defaults may retain precise versioned source/default dispositions. This cannot excuse ignored operator values, false exact claims or an unresolved critical invariant.

For required settings, independently identify the actual public option or selected operator/environment reader and effective consumption. Follow precise claims through conversion, precedence, sentinel/default translation, units, validation/clamps and terminal consumer; resolve accessible delegates. Required casing, empty/unset, invalid, numeric/fractional/range/overflow, enum/no-op and higher-priority/fallback cases come from inputs that actually reach that selected reader or the precise behavior claimed. Fixed typed options instead need their applied value, units, native API, startup wiring and operator-preservation assertions; constants alone do not select every malformed SDK permutation. Do not excuse ignored active inputs or false fallback claims. Keep unresolved reader/wiring boundaries explicit, distinct owners/defaults/diagnostics separate, and native APIs distinct from serialized representations. Named controls across existing related scenarios may satisfy a selected profile when every setting/assertion and required execution boundary is addressable; a helper or different-boundary result cannot close normal-launch or combined runtime proof. Preserve SDK-disabled versus retained propagation and separate bridge flags.

Prove normal-launcher operator/identity variants, rather than inferring them from helpers. Same-path conjunctions require joint proof. Separate focused SDK/bridge/receiver, app-test and normal-runtime boundaries under consistent scenario IDs; scalar proof levels cover every constituent assertion, and either requires adequate alternatives for the same contract. Never borrow another control's strongest mode/visibility. Direct instrumentation without an audit retains concrete selected future controls. Judge actual omissions/overclaims, not chronology, row count or constant finalizer syntax alone. For promised optional modes resolve actual named activation or a supported default. Follow the exact selected overload and terminal native/container conversion. Reconcile text finding/control IDs and every promised carrier/metadata field to its actual owner and predicate; known IDs and general propagation paragraphs alone are insufficient. Preserve valid operator signal-specific local log headers through official SDK parsing, without empty overrides; a generic-header conflict must remain distinct and isolated to the added local log path. Bind a catalog of selected source operations and promised outcomes to predicates, parameters, outputs/lifecycle phases and asserting scenarios. A shared global scan or complete parameterization is valid when its capture scope and witnesses of every selected operation are explicit; literal operation-name matches and duplicated tests are not required. A broad statement that all captured records are covered is not an operation/phase witness. Keep unmapped bindings open. Bind privacy trails to the logging finding they prove; another record's pass or a general test list cannot allocate its fields. For application-owned SDK-disabled guards, verify selected propagation setup remains reachable and test carrier extraction through that same disabled init path; provider registration alone cannot prove it. For selected application fallback promises, distinguish case inputs, final value/tuple and winning owner, and named assertions; one generic-only launch does not allocate empty/absent/malformed and both-absent branches. Source-only delegated defaults do not select runtime permutations. A related launch can witness an absent-setting case when its effective inputs and actual assertions are retained; require neither a literal case name nor duplicate execution. Reconcile new application-owned readers as well as bound audit controls, without imposing unused SDK-reader suites.

Identifies actual native logging,SDK/agent/provider/bridge ownership and startup reachability. Uses one supported owner per record,retains original sinks and does not infer a working pipeline from environment variables alone.

Preserves record semantics:actual WARN mapping,source occurrence versus observed time,bounded useful bodies and supported structured values. Does not invent mandatory EventName,exception payloads or unsupported SDK capabilities. Bind appender value support to the resolved dependency and its actual bridge path. An upstream main-branch mapper, another release, or a direct typed-SDK empty-array test cannot establish bridge preservation. Classify an observed selected-value limitation without imposing a fixed release or replacing the provider; ordinary absent optional values remain valid. Numeric severity band names do not prescribe SeverityText casing. Derive exact text from the selected bridge/source mapping; do not require uppercase WARN/INFO/ERROR when that bridge emits lowercase warn/info/error. Distinguish optional absent text with a permitted short-name substitution from replacing a present source value; audit expectations must match verified or explicitly unverified capability.

Requires or proves canonical log TraceId and SpanId joins to exact real SDK spans,with parentage and source-backed Resource identity. Ordinary attributes,nonempty IDs,shared TraceId or stdout correlation alone are insufficient. Derive the expected SpanId from the actual bridge/API-selected context, including supported caller-side capture when used. A framework INTERNAL child is valid with the correct verified request ancestry; an unsupported SERVER-only expectation is not. Do not remove legitimate layer spans or overwrite valid context solely to satisfy an invented topology. For cross-process correlation, assess the actual peer carrier and installed propagator capability before assigning a logger/context repair. Preserve emitted flags and runtime constraints; report an unsupported peer feature honestly rather than stripping flags, manually copying IDs or silently raising the runtime floor. A supported-stack positive workflow still requires its real end-to-end join. Rejection of a valid peer carrier remains a propagator dependency conformance gap; do not relabel it optional covered behavior or treat an unsupported report as a successful join.

Addresses the actual owned executor/goroutine/callback path and concurrent left/right request pairing. Reuses verified Java/Node propagation;identifies or repairs missing Go request-context and Python executor propagation. Separate sync and async probes cannot prove the same worker-to-real-span path. Scope error/cancellation controls to existing owned behavior or clearly labeled supported SDK probes. Do not require a new business cancellation feature on an app with no such path; ending a span or detaching context cannot be counted as canceling scheduled work. Preserve all controls already required by the bound contract, executing them or retaining them as not proven. When the bound contract requests repeated keep-alive or executor/thread reuse, one concurrent left/right pair is insufficient. Retain actual repeated-round/reuse assertions and evidence, or keep those controls unproven; do not infer them from general context propagation. A selected reuse probe must exercise the same execution unit with distinct work-item contexts and context-free work; fresh concurrent workers sharing one context do not prove that reuse or request isolation. A missing-transfer probe must omit transfer on the selected handoff path; a direct outside-context emit is a different control. Preserve caller detach/restore. Do not add business worker behavior merely for an optional focused capability probe, or remove a focused probe already bound.

Distinguishes legitimate outside-span/unsampled context from broken wiring. No stale request IDs on startup logs,no fabricated spans/forced sampling,and explicit uncertainty for unexecuted cases. For an exact unsampled claim, compare canonical IDs/flags to independently observed SDK context selected by the logging/bridge API for that record and claimed boundary, including explicit context or caller-side capture. Do not substitute the ambient context of a later queue/export worker. Matching trace, nonempty SpanId or two agreeing logs cannot establish the expected request SpanId. Do not require exported unsampled spans or production identifier fields. Audit chooses a supported observation/mode before binding; a focused oracle cannot later close a bound full-runtime exact-value claim.

Applies source-backed privacy and exception scope without introducing raw request IDs,unbounded errors or unsupported alias requirements. Bounded left/right categories are permitted;ordinary native messages do not require instrumentation-only exception events. When a selected privacy probe exposes framework/access/error renderer content captured by the path, do not defer it merely as dependency-owned. Preserve permitted diagnostic category, effective level, sinks and application behavior while removing policy-forbidden values at the policy-selected boundary; blanket suppression is not redaction. Inspect a supported native hook or explicitly leave a genuinely unsupported boundary unresolved, then rerun the actual failing probe in native and OTLP output. Inspect all framework records captured by the selected bridge, not only a fixed-message/application-logger allowlist; separately routed SDK diagnostics retain their own boundary. For captured Spring MVC error/argument diagnostics, select a supported resolved hook on the actual producer path. Framework exception handling is a capability lead when needed; a supported logging-only repair that preserves the selected boundary does not require a controller change or investigation of every alternative. Preserve response status/headers/body and diagnostic category, and replay the same malformed request without subsequent raw-value/stack logging. Inspect the actual native producer: a Tomcat JULI/JUL container record may bypass MVC exception handlers before reaching the bridge. Resolve the installed producer/LogRecord/Filter/Handler/bridge APIs, including whether filters run and parameter/throwable rendering; avoid mutation after async handoff, global per-request logger-level changes or replacement of operator handlers. Audit plans this investigation, instrumentation repairs and replays a supported selected path, and verification reports the actual boundary without unauthorized app edits. For each selected error path, inspect accessible producer code before choosing a hook; a retained source file or a trail template alone does not resolve the mechanism. For unresolved capability, name the exact source symbol/event/API edge, owner and next inspection/probe observation that distinguishes supported repair from an unsupported boundary. Retain a source-bound producer/call-site → native event → supported policy-boundary hook/action → later renderers → native/SDK outputs trail, with sentinel-absence AND permitted-category assertions at each covered output. A deny-only hook cannot preserve a required category. An unresolved producer/event/API edge needs its owner and exact next source/probe check, not a generic formatter assessment. Apply shared record predicates through explicit operation bindings or the complete shared/global scan or parameterization with covered outputs, phases and operation witnesses accepted by criterion2.

Assess effective selected log-attribute count/value limits or unlimited behavior, defaults, precedence and construction cost. Resolve the actual startup-to-provider/bridge configuration and enforcement needed for selected outcomes or exact claims; explicit processors or public options alone do not establish forwarding or bypass. Follow claimed normalization and diagnostic delegates, including accessible source before installation. Ordinary delegated SDK defaults need no exhaustive unused-setting/permutation suite; retain versioned ownership/default or scoped unsupported/unverified evidence without claiming runtime proof.

Distinguish strings/characters from byte arrays, recursive array/map value limits from top-level attribute count, depth counting/replacement from unsupported depth, and actual discard/eviction/drop accounting. Preserve selected model-specific/general fallback and programmatic precedence. Exercise below/at/above selected bounds, supplied/changed settings and expressly claimed supported shapes/cadence. Direct SDK emission cannot prove a separately selected native logger/handler/appender path; retain bridge-added attributes and drop accounting. A source option or successful truncation cannot establish diagnostic cadence.

Common limit diagnostics MAY be emitted, but truncation/discard/replacement diagnostics MUST occur at most once per affected record; preserve the separate Logs SDK discard-diagnostic SHOULD. Resolve relevant emission paths/once guards. First establish a limit-induced record-data change: invalid-key/uniqueness messages and configuration warnings returning unchanged values do not automatically count as limit diagnostics. Separate source-known guards/no-emission facts from executed cadence proof and retain real upstream limitations.

Keep Body/privacy policy distinct from attribute limits and Resource exemptions; span limits do not configure log limits. Guard actually expensive selected construction with supported enablement checks and prove disabled/filter/opt-out avoids that work. Do not impose expensive guards on cheap fixed messages, arbitrary Body caps, fabricated capture paths, duplicate suppression/providers, SDK replacement or forced upgrades. Unsupported/development features remain explicit; unverified defaults cannot close selected privacy, safe-cost or operator-limit invariants.

Identify actual batch/exporter/lifecycle owners. Separate native calls, enqueue, attempts, received copies, acknowledged accepted, rejected, dropped, unknown and persistence; healthy one-per-call receipts differ from retries. Audit plans selected controls; runtime claims require current execution.

Decode each request's N and match batches/attempts to actual client terminal outcomes before totals. Conforming HTTP200 with the selected ExportLogsServiceResponse encoding and partial_success unset acknowledges N accepted/0 rejected. Populated partial with R rejected acknowledges N-R/R; warning-only R=0 acknowledges N/0. Both populated cases MUST NOT retry. When protocol response classification is selected or claimed, preserve concrete full/partial/warning assertions even when future-only or direct instrumentation lacks an audit. Otherwise retain accurate delegated capability/ownership without selecting a protocol conformance suite merely by using OTLP. Invalid/unrelated200 bodies do not establish conformance. Unknown acceptance remains legitimate for unresolved negative/size failures; acknowledgement, record identity and persistence stay separate.

Distinguish completed negative responses from stalls using client/receiver evidence, not server intent, null counts or aggregate elapsed time. Retain per-outcome counts/raw links, request fingerprints, attempt timestamps and measured waits when selected; mixed failures cannot inherit unqualified otlp_accepted visibility. Use a retry-capable policy and positive retryable-response control to prove non-retry classification; disabled/exhausted retries prove neither. HTTP429/502/503/504 SHOULD retry; other4xx/5xx MUST NOT. Preserve operator retry policy, throttling representation/conditions, no early retry beyond remaining budget, separate recovery from exhaustion, and independently selected direct-export, processor, cancellation and persistent-failure controls.

Trace exact deadline claims through real creation, propagation, waits/retries and consumption. Distinguish serialized assignments, units, effective defaults/fallbacks, configured/per-attempt/whole-export budgets and measured durations. An after-failure elapsed check is not necessarily a strict ceiling; retain overshoot and earlier enclosing cancellation. Process/shutdown time cannot prove batch deadlines. Preserve selected processor Export synchronization without duplicate app locking or confusion with exporter request concurrency.

Prove selected final-record drain through normal launch and the actual configured application path, with that record's body/count/time, expected Resource and valid associated or absent context. Focused export, live snapshots, opt-out or cleanup cannot substitute. Reconcile effective launcher signal ownership. For selected repeated-stop controls, deliver the specified second request to the same process during active final logging/provider drain and retain event order, actual outcome and budget. A selected uninterrupted-drain policy requires non-interruption and once-only finalization; policy-permitted forced termination follows its separate control.

Retain transport-limit clauses and ownership only when selected under criterion14; ordinary delegated HTTP use alone does not select them. Require concrete selected application/claimed-guarantee controls; truthful delegated-default/external dispositions do not require exhaustive upstream receiver certification. No unresolved external capability closes a critical application delivery/safety invariant. Never add custom app parsers/retries merely to expose SDK internals. For fixtures with the documented Graceful-stop contract in README.md, this is application policy, not an OTel signal-handler requirement. Account for every received request, not only the final snapshot; retain terminal outcomes for partial/warning trials. SDK success alone cannot prove response-body decoding. During instrumentation, safely executable selected final-drain proof remains required work unless genuinely blocked. A selected stop plan names request kind, recipient and launcher→effective application handler/finalizer path, expected outcome, budget/source, observable order and its own final-record predicate. A selected retry trial names a source-supported retryable response/connection event, batch/trial identity, existing SDK policy/wait source, remaining budget, measured wait/range and terminal outcome. Existing SDK backoff/jitter is sufficient when selected; server throttling is not automatically required. Distinguish failed-batch recovery from only later healthy batches; prove the actual claimed scope and persistent failure ending by its deadline/eligibility rule. A generic immediate-failure/stall label is not a retry stimulus. Keep permitted forced-repeat and uninterrupted-drain outcomes separate; force cannot establish graceful drain or imply final-record receipt. Retain independently observed receipts accurately; source-proven interruption of required drain needs repair. Different decoded record sets alone do not establish retry lineage. Retain unmatched batch client outcomes as unknown; do not assign server intent or another export's deadline result. Unknown acceptance or no observed acknowledgement cannot support unqualified log otlp_accepted, while a known completed client error remains completed. A valid shared final-record predicate must actually run against that final record/phase with its own context and time interval; another healthy trial cannot supply it.

Checks applicable diagnostic routing and configured-signal isolation. Source review or healthy traffic does not establish an outage test;unexecuted fault/optional SDK cases remain explicitly unproven instead of fabricated passes. Match only the fault/operation combinations actually selected by the bound contract to their own native output, diagnostics, progress and unrelated-signal receipts. A one-operation stall cannot cover a selected refusal or another required operation; do not invent an unselected cross-product. Keep unexecuted combinations open while retaining independently proven direct item scope.

Uses fresh source/command/dependency-bound evidence with actual outcome counts and retained failures. Honors required project runtime and configured local endpoints. A copied old receipt,stale source or zero exit without execution cannot establish current verification. Resolve saved local execution-evidence references to existing retained artifacts. Report trace_ids from that specific scenario operation/receipt or leave them empty when unproven; copying the first IDs from a different request into every row is inaccurate even when the source trial passed. Retain distinct trial storage on the actual filesystem: case-only names may refer to one overwritten file. Check each retained result input/case identity against the claimed trial; two case aliases cannot establish separate true/TRUE controls.

Preserves application routes,behavior,operator identity and original sinks;keeps local logs local and makes no unrequested SDK upgrades,cloud configuration or unrelated business instrumentation. Supported defaults and upstream library duties are not automatically missing application code. Treat effective resource-only service.name as operator identity when OTEL_SERVICE_NAME is absent. New Make/shell/CLI/image/JVM fallbacks must not replace it or discard other resource attributes. Distinguish an explicit supported service-name override from a fallback; use SDK parsing/actual merge behavior, not a custom resource parser. Audit plans the normal-launcher acceptance check; implementation/verification proves applicable resource-only, explicit-override and absent-identity cases. A helper-only pass cannot establish the normal launcher preserves identity. When service.version or another resource field is explicitly promised, require its source-backed expected value and preservation assertion at the declared boundary; name/environment-only checks do not close it. Genuinely unavailable/unpromised optional version metadata remains absent, not invented. Include Java-SDK-accepted whitespace around resource entries through the normal launcher when a new fallback is introduced. A compact-only identity test misses shell substring checks that append an overriding duplicate; preserve supplied configuration and SDK parsing rather than implementing a shell resource parser. For normal-launch identity variants, construct the actual child environment with conflicting inherited keys removed, account for active loader/profile inputs, and inspect the received Resource. An inherited explicit service name cannot establish a resource-only or absent-identity trial.

Reconcile primary logging clauses needed for selected application behavior, supplied operator policy, app-owned or changed configuration, source-backed risks and actual capability claims in the normal canonical report by source/version/date, conditions, requirement strength, maturity, owner, capability/disposition and proof boundary. Exact normative/conformance claims retain exact clause bindings. Unchanged delegated SDK/receiver duties may use compact versioned source/default/unsupported/unverified dispositions without reproducing every imported clause or selecting tests of unselected inputs, shapes or features. This never closes a missing selected application invariant or an unproven runtime claim. The exhaustive OTel guidance inventory and source-to-skill clause review are PR-level maintenance acceptance, not a deliverable repeated by every bare application workflow. Retain distinct recommendations, permissions and mandatory fallbacks, including normative imports and compatibility qualifications. For precise normative/conformance claims, bounded retained excerpts or exact immutable-audit evidence-row references may carry unchanged clauses; generic URLs, nearby SDK comments or topic summaries cannot establish those claims. Unchanged delegated defaults may use compact versioned source/ownership/limitation evidence without a per-service sibling-clause ledger. Refresh current capabilities/outcomes after installation/probes without inheriting old runtime success.

Allocate duties to the actual SDK, bridge, instrumentation/semantic-convention author, application, receiver or operator. Supported SDK defaults need no duplicate application implementation. Apply criterion2's configuration scope: every selected app/operator promise and actual capability claim needs adequate evidence; unused upstream settings/permutations need no exhaustive inventory/conformance suite. Unselected sibling SDK/receiver duties require no per-service clause ledger. Use scoped source/default/unsupported/unverified facts where needed to explain selected behavior, with unknown effects and conditional resolution steps. These dispositions never establish unproven runtime behavior or close critical selected invariants. Do not retrospectively remove promises or pass current outputs.

Before requiring a transport-bound entry, identify the selecting app-owned/changed bound, supplied operator policy, source-backed size/decompression risk or precise related capability/conformance claim. Ordinary delegated HTTP export, endpoint/timeout setup or an acknowledged status/body limitation alone does not select every sibling size/decompression duty. For actually selected duties retain only the necessary separate receiver request-bound/decompression MUST/413, exporter request-bound SHOULD/no-send-above-active-bound MUST/discard SHOULD, client response-bound/decompression MUST/non-retryable-oversize MUST/discard SHOULD, and receiver response-bound MUST clauses. Preserve oversized partial-response reduction SHOULD when possible/practical, optional diagnostic trimming MAY, still-oversize500 MUST with unspecified acceptance, configurability SHOULD and recommended—not mandatory application—64MiB/4MiB values. Use corresponding gRPC clauses when selected. An externally owned receiver needs accurate owner/disposition, not certification as an ordinary app prerequisite; actual receiver conformance/implementation claims require evidence at that receiver, not a synthetic substitute.

Read concrete repairs and exact claims against actual public APIs, constructor/options/units, startup/configuration precedence and consuming enforcement, including parser/normalizer/diagnostic/default/retry delegates. Documentation alone, an unused helper or Not run label cannot substantiate a source-resolvable exact claim; retain contradictions honestly. Scoped probes establish their actual boundary. Preserve private-extension applicability rather than imposing unrelated standard defaults. Do not impose arbitrary tuning, framework recipes, SDK rewrites/upgrades or application fixes for upstream-owned limitations. Reconcile retained primary and imported sources to exact bound sections, preserving implication direction. For selected processor behavior, a source-backed risk or an actual processor-conformance claim, retain the applicable SDK-owned OnEmit synchrony/nonblocking/nonthrowing, independent-filtering and mutation-visibility dispositions. Assess independent OnEmit filtering when the selected processor filters and supports Enabled, or wraps a filtering processor; a default LoggerConfig claim alone does not select those sibling duties. Otherwise compact unchanged SDK/default source and ownership evidence suffices, without a per-service sibling-clause ledger. Preserve the full clause-to-skill inventory for requested maintenance. Keep source-known response defaults/status/body handling separate from unresolved adapters/runtime, without demanding unrelated upstream certification. Qualify selected maturity separately for the normative specification and actual installed/proposed component/API. A stable data model cannot establish SDK/bridge stability, and a source comment about one component cannot establish the whole language is beta. Keep absent/uninspected status honest without forced upgrades.
